title: fix(scripts): measure-self-test-floor's probe awards HELD only on a printed handshake, never on a bare non-zero exit
body:
Fixes #15324

`probeEarlyReturn()` in `scripts/measure-self-test-floor.mjs` decided its verdict on the mutated run's exit code and nothing else:

```js
verdict: mut.status === 0 ? 'DEFEATED' : 'HELD',
```

So a dispatch spelled `process.exit(runSelfTest() === 0 ? 0 : 1)` scored **HELD**: the injected early return makes `runSelfTest()` yield `undefined`, `undefined === 0` is false, and the process exits 1 having printed **zero bytes**. Nothing noticed anything — the arithmetic of a comparison against a missing return value did it. That is the same accident-versus-handshake mistake this instrument exists to expose, made by the instrument on itself, and it inflates exactly the completion picture a green `--probe` sweep is quoted for.

The row already carried `mutatedBytes` and `mutatedHead`. The verdict now reads them.

## What changed

A non-zero exit is a hold only when the mutated run also **spoke** — printed a non-blank line, the same reading `mutatedHead` already publishes and the HELD listing already quotes (a run whose whole output is a newline has non-zero bytes and refused nothing). The verdict is three-valued:

| verdict | condition |
|:--|:--|
| `DEFEATED` | exit 0 — the early return went unnoticed |
| `HELD` | exit != 0 **and** the mutated run printed a non-blank line |
| `ACCIDENT` | exit != 0 **and** it printed nothing — never counted among HELD |

`ACCIDENT` is tallied and listed apart in `--probe`, with a trailing note so the number cannot be skimmed as a hold.

The verdict deliberately does **not** match the refusal *wording*. The repair landed in three spellings and teaching this verdict any of them is the coupling #14968 is filed to remove; reporting which handshake a file carries is that card's column, not this verdict's job. This is the card's own recommendation A, with C left to #14968.

**Additive only.** `mutatedSpoke` joins the row; no `--json` key is renamed and no row keying changes. `classifyFloor` is untouched.

## The instrument's own controls

This file ships no `--self-test` — its controls run inline on every invocation, so they cannot become unrun. A third fixture joins them, the measured accident shape reduced (`process.exit(runSelfTest() === 0 ? 0 : 1)` over a self-test with no handshake), asserted to read `ACCIDENT` with a non-zero exit and zero bytes. Two further assertions pin the discriminator from both sides: the accident fixture must still *produce* that shape (or the `ACCIDENT` above would pass for the wrong reason), and the handshake-protected fixture must be one that **spoke** when defeated.

Ablation, on the committed implementation: reverting only the verdict expression back to the exit-code-only form (mutation confirmed on disk — new expression 0 hits, old expression 1 hit, blob hash differs from the `HEAD` blob; the instrument is run directly as source, so there is no build step to reach) makes the instrument refuse itself, `exit 1`:

```
measure-self-test-floor: ITS OWN CONTROLS FAILED -- no census printed.

  - POSITIVE CONTROL FAILED: the probe read a silent non-zero exit as HELD () -- an exit code is not a handshake
```

Restore proven by hash: restored blob `00f6d4d6ee85eeb8c00710b2f4fcc66750d2f9af` equals the `HEAD` blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Before / after, measured

Whole population, `node scripts/measure-self-test-floor.mjs --probe --json`, exit 0 both sides. Base `c4d1354e3`, branch `cc3fc2def`.

| file | base | branch | mutatedExit | mutatedBytes |
|:--|:--|:--|--:|--:|
| `scripts/audits/14744-before-update-per-row-value-census.mjs` | `HELD` | **`ACCIDENT`** | 1 | 0 |
| `scripts/check-turbo-task-graph.mjs` (sentinel) | `HELD` | `HELD` | 1 | 211 |
| `scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` (flag) | `HELD` | `HELD` | 1 | 224 |
| `scripts/check-parse-guard.mjs` (flag) | `HELD` | `HELD` | 1 | 203 |

The genuine holds still quote their real refusal lines, unchanged:

```
✗ check-turbo-task-graph self-test: runSelfTest() returned without reaching its verdict,
✗ check-durability-degradation-log-level self-test: selfTest() returned without reaching its verdict,
✗ check-parse-guard self-test: selfTest() returned without reaching its verdict,
```

The card names `check-platform-checklist.mjs` as the helper-spelling contrast. It cannot serve as one: its `ENTRY_BY_HAND` row is `null`, so it reads `NOT MEASURED` on both sides and no probe run exercises the helper form at all. `check-parse-guard.mjs` stands in above, and the coverage gap is filed as #15371 — not addressed here.

**Verdict changes across the whole population: exactly one**, the file named above. Every other row is byte-identical.

**Floor classification is unchanged**, asserted explicitly — this card is about the probe verdict, not the floor:

| | base `c4d1354e3` | branch `cc3fc2def` |
|:--|--:|--:|
| rows | 170 | 170 |
| `ROSTER` | 162 | 162 |
| `COUNT` | 1 | 1 |
| `NONE` | 7 | 7 |

Per-file floor classification compared as an ordered `file:floor` join: identical.

`--probe` tallies, branch:

```
Hole 2 -- silently defeated by an early `return` in the self-test (MEASURED):
  0 DEFEATED, 164 HELD, 1 ACCIDENT, 5 NOT MEASURED.
    ACC   scripts/audits/14744-before-update-per-row-value-census.mjs -- exited 1 printing 0 byte(s); no refusal, so NOT a hold

⚠ ACCIDENT is not a hold. Those 1 file(s) exit non-zero because a comparison
   against a missing return value happened to be false, not because anything noticed.
```

## Gates, on `cc3fc2def`

Exit codes captured by redirect before any pipe.

- Derived family, `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (19 commands, derived by the script from the merge base — no hand-built change set): **all 19 exit 0.**
- Always-runs tail: `check:pm-dispatch-gates` (`✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 1382 cases pass.`), `check-self-test-workflow-commands.mjs` and its `--self-test`, `check:declared-population-live`, `check-self-test-wired.mjs` and its `--self-test`, `check:ratchet-remedy-authority`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:watch-hint-literal` — **all exit 0.**
- The six artifact rosters flagged as sitting under `scripts/`, read rather than assumed clear: `check-published-list-mirrors.mjs` (+ `--self-test`), `check:console-injection`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:i18n-stale-fill` — **exit 0.** `check:published-readme-exports` is **NOT MEASURED**: it needs a whole-repo `pnpm build` this fresh worktree has not run, and every one of its findings is `packages/**/README.md` naming a missing `dist/*.d.ts` with its own remedy `Build first`. Zero of its findings touch this diff's one path.
- Whole-repo `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`) — **exit 0, zero findings**, run to completion rather than narrowed.
- Control-byte scan of the edited file beyond the gate (`grep -naP` over the C0 set plus DEL): no matches.

`skip-changeset`: this PR publishes nothing from any package — one file under `scripts/`, an internal measurement instrument with no package entry point.

Same-file family, out of scope here: #14963, #14842 and #15339 remain open. #15339 in particular overlaps the file but not the function — it is about `PRODUCES_FAILURE` in `classifyFloor` (the static floor criterion), while this changes only `probeEarlyReturn`'s verdict; the two do not touch the same lines.
